title: Bike Night of Giving Tonight: Riders Bring Turkeys and Canned Food for Neighbors in Need

content:
Motorcycles, music and food will fill BMG Xtreme Sports tonight — and every rider and visitor is invited to bring a turkey or canned food to help neighbors put Thanksgiving dinner on the table.

Bike Night of Giving runs Thursday, Nov. 19, from 7 to 9 p.m. at BMG Xtreme Sports, 6420 Sinatra Parkway. The shop is partnering with Angels on Earth for a turkey and canned food drive, and organizers describe tonight as the “last call” for donations.

“GOOD RIDES. GREAT PEOPLE. AN EVEN GREATER CAUSE!” BMG wrote in announcing the event. “LAST CALL FOR THE TURKEY & CANNED FOOD DRIVE!”

Riders and non-riders are both welcome, and the evening includes music and food alongside the bike gathering. Donations of turkeys and canned goods will go to families in need ahead of Thanksgiving.

It comes as food banks, churches, schools and community groups across Laredo collect holiday meals for families this week, with several Thanksgiving giveaways and gatherings planned around the city.

Sources: BMG Xtreme Sports, Nov. 5, 2026.
